metadata.description: Qt Python plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: qt-python-ui-testing
plugins.description: Reviewing or automating GUI tests for a `Qt for Python` application. Simulate real mouse/keyboard interaction and capture what actually rendered (screenshots), instead of only instantiating a widget and asserting its properties.

plugins.name: qt-development-skills
plugins.description: Agentic engineering skills for Qt software development, including Qt C++/QML code review, QML coding, and Qt C++/QML code documentation. Bundles the hosted Qt Documentation MCP server for live Qt API lookups. These skills use AI and can make mistakes. Always double-check the output carefully.
